thread:
maya: Quick sync — I want a compact risk matrix + consolidated customer asks for the observability launch. Drop constraints, must-haves, and mitigations here. Goal: ship dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown in the next release window.
jordan: Starting list:
- MVP dashboards: cost (per-model), latency (P50/P95), errors (per-route)
- Tracing hooks: instrument 2 hot paths (inference + batch enqueue)
- Cost breakdown: per-route and per-model attribution for top customers
- Error analytics: sample-by-error-type + traces for top 50 errors
tim: Helpful. Quick ACs so we can scope:```
ACs:
- Dashboards show token cost, P95 latency, error rate per model and per-route
- Tracing: toggleable hook, captures span for model selection + kernel fallback, <100ms p99 overhead in canary
- Cost breakdown: per-route attribution + export CSV for top 100 customers
- Error analytics: stack traces + first-occurrence spike detection, alert when 3x baseline
- Rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on SLA violation
```
sasha: Ops concerns: if tracing overhead >200ms we need auto-disable; sampling should default to 1% for public tenants, 100% for enterprise opt-in. Also need retention policy (30d default, 90d enterprise).
lee (cs): Customer asks we've collected this week: BankAlpha: end-to-end trace export + SOC export; Finco: cost-per-call / monthly invoice export; PlatformTeam: dashboard templates + per-model anomaly alerts. They want ETA and gating criteria.
maya: Good. Quick risk matrix (short):
- Risk: Tracing adds latency -> Mitigation: default low sample, canary perf tests, auto-disable rule (sasha)
- Risk: Cost attribution mismatch -> Mitigation: reconcile job + manual override + sample verifications (jordan)
- Risk: Data retention/privacy -> Mitigation: enterprise-only exports behind VPC + KMS logging (legal OK)
- Risk: Dashboard overload (noise) -> Mitigation: curated default slices + quick filter UX (design follow-up)
jordan: UX ask — we need two dashboard templates: "Cost Hotspots" and "Latency Heatmap". Keep widget set to 6 default widgets so customers can get value without customizing.
tim: Implementation notes: prioritize backend endpoints for per-route attribution and a lightweight trace hook API. We'll gate full sampling until attribution job is stable.
sasha: Operational gating: we require SLO smoke tests in staging, must pass p99 latency increase <5% for canary before wider rollout. Also add alert: tracing ingestion error rate >0.1% triggers rollback.
lee (cs): For communication: propose a customer-facing doc that lists: feature matrix (MVP vs Enterprise), rollout timeline, how to opt-in, data residency notes. I'll start a draft.
maya: Decisions for now: 1) include tracing hooks in MVP but default to 1% sampling public, 100% enterprise opt-in; 2) dashboards are MVP with export CSV; 3) cost attribution gated behind reconciliation job but visible in canary. If everyone ok, I’ll create tickets and a short RACI.
jordan: :thumbsup: ok from design side.
sasha: +1 from SRE, will draft auto-disable rule.
tim: +1, engineering will spike attribution job this sprint.
prod-bot: Created issue INF-4012 (Observability: MVP dashboards + tracing hooks + cost attribution) assigned to @tim, due 3012400000.
maya: Thanks — @lee (cs) please drop customer doc link here when ready; @jordan please share the two dashboard templates as screenshots or JSON so we can include in scope. We'll use this thread as the canonical ask list.
lee (cs): Will post doc draft by EOD.
jordan: I’ll attach template JSONs in a follow-up message.
maya: Closing note — we should surface a short launch checklist in Console: enable toggle, retention notice, billing impact estimate. Keep updates here. :rocket:
